items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps the routine comfortable while skin gets used to a night retinol.
Retinol 0.3% is a gentler first step than the 1% serum for smoother-looking texture and softer-looking fine lines.
A ceramide moisturizer helps with the low moisture score and cushions skin against retinol dryness.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is needed because retinol makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol serum at night just 2 nights a week at first, then add nights slowly as skin stays comfortable, and wear the SPF every morning. I left out the 1% serum and the retinal eye cream because using two strong retinol-type products from the start is likely to irritate; the eye cream can be added later once skin is comfortable, in place of, not on top of, the serum around the eyes.
